newsitem.title: USA: MedImmune, BioTransplant get trial okay.
newsitem.headline: MedImmune, BioTransplant get trial okay.

text.p: MedImmune Inc said Tuesday that it and BioTransplant Inc received clearance from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration to begin human clinical trials with MEDI-507, a humanized form of their organ transplant drug BTI-322.

MedImmune said that one-year follow-up results from a Phase I/II trial in which the BTI-322 monoclonal antibody was given at the time of organ transplantation reduced the incidence of kidney graft rejection episodes by 58 percent compared with conventional triple drug therapy alone.
From laboratory studies, it appears that BTI-322 and MEDI-507 are eliminating only those T cells which initiate organ rejection while not affecting other T cells, it said.
The conventional triple drug regimen consists of cyclosporine, azathioprine and steroids.
